Our published work has identified lipid-signalling pathways associated with cellular
senescence and impaired tissue function. Current studies examine how these pathways can be
interrogated pharmacologically in muscle and senescence models.

## Translational direction

Mechanistic studies are combined with cellular phenotyping to determine whether modulation of lipid
signalling can improve regenerative outcomes. Compound structures, optimisation strategy and
assay-development details are withheld while intellectual-property work proceeds.
